Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.web.admin

Class UsersAdminController

java.lang.Object
com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.web.admin.UsersAdminController
@RestController @PreAuthorize("hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") public class UsersAdminController extends Object
REST adapter for the admin user-management endpoints (REQ-USR-001 .. REQ-USR-006, design §6.2.2).

Class-level @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") is defense in depth on top of the URL-level rule /api/v1/admin/** → hasRole('ADMIN') from US-04-009. Both layers reject STANDARD JWTs and SYSTEM API-key callers with 403.

No class-level @RequestMapping: the /api/v1 prefix is applied centrally by WebConfig (REQ-API-006). Mirrors the ApiKeysAdminController pattern from EPIC-04.
